_note: All prices and specs verified via ExaSearch/ExaContents against brand websites and authorized retailers as of July 2026; prices fluctuate with frequent sale promotions (e.g., 4th of July, seasonal discounts) so priceNote reflects the observed range at time of research. Sunlighten mPulse models do not publish list prices publicly (quote-based); Nordic Wave, BlueCube, and several others are omitted or partial where duplicate coverage of the required brand list was already met by verified alternates (e.g., 'Cold Plunge' brand product was sourced from an authorized dealer since coldplunge.com corporate pricing pages were not directly indexed). Ratings are third-party review scores (Garage Gym Reviews, ColdPlungePlus, Longeviters) where available; null indicates no independently verified star rating was found.
